evidence: legacy_counts: the CRLF check runs before chomp and compares against "---\r\n", so CRLF pages are counted in $crlf and skipped. close($h) still runs after the loop, so $. resets between files.
projects_of: chomp leaves the \r, so "---\r" never equals "---" and CRLF pages are skipped there too. This agrees with legacy_counts.
slug now takes <index> <project>. Both call sites in the diff pass the index and increment idx, and the idx counters are reset before each loop. I saw no other caller in the diff.
gocache is read before the XDG variables are overridden and is passed to go build explicitly. That matches the commit's stated intent.
opendir with grep { /\.md$/ && -f } replaces glob, so file names containing spaces are no longer split. The list is sorted, so the order is deterministic.
